pricing_note: Recommended internal launch prices only. These figures are not evidence of what any current or former customer paid and are not approved for publication.

offers.name: Live Website Decision Diagnostic
scope: Kickoff questionnaire and one 30-minute decision call
Review homepage, one primary service path, contact path, and representative mobile behavior
Three to five prioritized and reproducible findings
Source-located decision brief with sequenced recommendation
One 30-minute readout and one written clarification round
exclusions: Full-site crawl for a large site
client_inputs: Live website and safe staging URL if applicable
Primary service or decision path
One business goal and one known constraint
One authorized decision maker
Optional read-only analytics or Search Console access when measurement is in scope
acceptance_criteria: Every inspected URL is named
Every material finding is reproducible or labeled as a hypothesis
Findings are prioritized
Recommendation distinguishes repair, rebuild, visibility, content, CRM, and workflow work
No unsupported performance or ranking/citation claim appears
offers.capacity_rule: Maximum three diagnostic starts per week; no free custom audit and no implementation inside the diagnostic.

offers.name: Website Optimization Sprint
scope: Confirmed baseline and prioritized sprint backlog
Up to five agreed repairs across no more than five representative public routes or one shared template family
One staging review and one consolidated revision round
Production release to the verified existing host
Desktop, mobile, and live verification with before-and-after evidence
client_inputs: Repository or CMS access and hosting access
Approved backup or recovery path
Current brand assets and source copy
Analytics definitions when measurement is included
One authorized approver with consolidated feedback
acceptance_criteria: Every agreed repair has a pass/fail check and before-state locator
Project tests and production build pass where available
Agreed desktop and mobile routes have no change-related blocking overflow or console error
Keyboard, focus, and reduced motion are checked where affected
Affected live routes, metadata, links, and forms are verified after release
Remaining issues are labeled deferred, blocked, or out of scope
offers.capacity_rule: Maximum two active optimization sprints; one route set and one prioritized backlog per sprint.

offers.name: Distinctive Website System
scope: Product and positioning brief for one primary audience and decision path
One committed visual direction and documented design system
Up to eight core public pages using up to four reusable page templates
Responsive production build in the agreed web stack
Client-supplied copy editing plus source-backed net-new copy for included core pages
Metadata, canonicals, sitemap, robots controls, internal links, and supported schema
One contact path, analytics event plan, included redirect map, and verified release
Two consolidated review rounds
exclusions: Brand strategy beyond the web system
Ecommerce, memberships, or complex web applications
Rankings, AI citations, or lead volume
client_inputs: One authorized decision maker and one source-of-truth content owner
Approved brand assets and factual service information
People, location, project proof, policy, and imagery-rights records
Existing domain, hosting, analytics, repository or CMS, and redirect context
Consolidated approval at direction and staging gates
acceptance_criteria: Included routes and templates match the signed page matrix
Approved content and assets are present without invented claims
Core content is available in meaningful HTML
Important routes have consistent metadata and canonical signals
Agreed responsive, keyboard, focus, reduced-motion, overflow, media, form, and console checks pass
Redirects and affected live routes are verified on the mapped production host
Known exclusions and third-party limitations are recorded
offers.capacity_rule: One active full website build; additional sold work must enter a dated queue.

offers.name: Search and Answer Visibility Program
scope: Foundation crawl, indexability, priority-question, entity, evidence, and measurement map
One focused service or topic cluster
At starting tier, up to two substantial new or revised source pages or one page plus two bounded technical/content repairs per month
Internal-link and supported-schema updates for changed routes
One dated visibility observation and monthly decision memo
One monthly working session and one consolidated revision round
exclusions: Guaranteed rankings, indexing, traffic, AI inclusion, or citations
client_inputs: Website, repository or CMS access
Search Console and analytics access when measurement is expected
Subject-matter reviewer and source documents
Accurate organization, service, people, location, credential, and proof facts
Monthly release approval within three business days
acceptance_criteria: Every changed page has a documented job and target question set
Claims are supported or explicitly labeled uncertain
Changed pages have crawlable content, intentional links, accurate facts, and supported schema
Monthly memo separates outputs, observations, and business outcomes
Production routes and changed technical signals are verified after release
offers.capacity_rule: Maximum three launch programs; monthly units do not roll over.

offers.name: Bounded Business Agent Implementation
scope: Workflow discovery and written worker contract
One workflow in one environment with one owner and one primary integration or data source
Read-only, inspection, classification, or draft/staging authority first
Validation, duplicate/retry handling, failure states, logs/receipts, and human review path
Test fixtures, acceptance run, operator guide, and one training session
Thirty calendar days of defect support for the agreed workflow
client_inputs: Named workflow owner and reviewer
Current process and representative non-sensitive examples
Expected output, failure examples, and baseline review time when available
Approved account, environment, least-privilege access route, and retention rules
Timely review of staged outputs
acceptance_criteria: Worker stays inside the agreed trigger, account/client boundary, sources, and actions
At least three representative fixtures and one failure fixture produce documented status and receipt
Duplicate and retry behavior is deterministic for accepted cases
Missing access, ambiguous routing, unsupported claims, and consequential actions fail closed or pause
Operator can inspect what the worker used, prepared, changed, or refused
Activation does not exceed signed authority; draft/read-only acceptance is valid completion
offers.capacity_rule: One active implementation; one workflow only; consequential authority is never bundled.
